0022600131.text: The Los Angeles Lakers, 3-0 and 1st in the Pacific, host the Portland Trail Blazers, who are 2-0 and sit 2nd in the Northwest, one game back, in the Lakers' fourth game of the season. Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, while Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Scoot Henderson is day-to-day with ankle soreness and listed as a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost 1-2 to Portland, most recently 132-116 in Portland on 2026-01-17.
